panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
The customer's most urgent line or pool (statuses from n360.v_contract_status, proposed thresholds), how many VAs it runs, its next term end and its CSM.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status, n360.va, n360.account  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT argMin(tuple(line_label, if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status), pct_billed, pct_term, days_left, cross_date),
                                tuple(status_rank, -ifNull(pct_billed, 0))) AS w
                 FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS ws,
             (SELECT count() FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS n_lines,
             (SELECT minIf(end_date, days_left >= 0) FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS next_end,
             (SELECT count() FROM n360.va WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS n_vas
        SELECT concat(a.display_name, ': ',
                      if(n_lines = 0, 'no contract line (unbilled)', multiIf(
                          ws.2 = 'over billed', concat(ws.1, ' is over billed (', toString(round(ws.3)), '%)'),
                          ws.2 = 'will exceed', concat(ws.1, ' is set to exceed billed on ', concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(ws.6)), ' ', formatDateTime(ws.6, '%b %Y'))),
                          ws.2 = 'renewal risk', concat(ws.1, ' is at renewal risk: ', toString(round(ws.3)), '% used, ',
                                                        toString(ws.5), ' days left'),
                          ws.2 = 'below pace', concat(ws.1, ' is below pace: ', toString(round(ws.3)), '% used, ',
                                                      toString(round(ws.4)), '% of the term gone'),
                          ws.2 IN ('on pace', 'ahead'), 'every line on pace',
                          ws.2 = 'too early', 'too early to tell',
                          'no line has a reading yet')),
                      ' · ', concat(toString(n_vas), if(n_vas = 1, ' VA', ' VAs')),
                      if(next_end = toDate(0) OR n_lines = 0, '', concat(' · next term end ', concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(next_end)), ' ', formatDateTime(next_end, '%b %Y')),
                         ' (', toString(dateDiff('day', (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded'), next_end)), ' days)')),
                      ' · CSM ', a.csm_rocketlane) AS sentence
        FROM n360.account AS a WHERE a.account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Contract status (most urgent line)
panels.description:
The status of this customer's most urgent line or pool, and which one it is. Colours: the contract status palette (Contracts).

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(arrayElement(['Over billed', 'Will exceed', 'Renewal risk', 'Below pace', 'Ahead', 'On pace', 'Too early to tell', 'Under review', 'Billed not recorded', 'Unmapped', 'Not built', 'Not measured', 'Not reported yet'], indexOf(['over billed', 'will exceed', 'renewal risk', 'below pace', 'ahead', 'on pace', 'too early', 'under review', 'billed not recorded', 'unmapped', 'not built', 'not measured', 'not read'], argMin(if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status), tuple(status_rank, -ifNull(pct_billed, 0))))),
                      ' · ', argMin(line_label, tuple(status_rank, -ifNull(pct_billed, 0)))) AS status
        FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) HAVING count() > 0

panels.title: Open tickets
panels.description:
Support tickets still open for this customer ("None open": tickets are exported and none is open; "Not reported yet": no ticket export). Priority is not exported yet. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if((SELECT count() FROM n360.ps_ticket) = 0, NULL,
                  if(countIf(status = 'open') = 0, 'None open', toString(countIf(status = 'open')))) AS t
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Needs attention
panels.description:
Items from the Overview's Needs attention list for this customer (same rule, proposed thresholds). Click one to open it.

**Source:** n360.v_needs_attention  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: Contract lines
panels.description:
Every line and pool, in its own contract measure; a pool's lines are listed under it for information, never against billed. The bar is % of billed (full at 100%; the number is the true %). At term end = the stored forecast's rate carried to the term end. Grey statuses have no reading ("Not reported yet", never zero). Click a line to open it.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status, n360.v_line_status  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Line, Status, `% of billed`, `% of term`, Used, Billed, `At term end`, `Term ends`, `Days left`, Measure, drill
        FROM (
            SELECT 0 AS o, status_rank AS r, line_label AS Line, if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status) AS Status, pct_billed AS `% of billed`,
                   pct_term AS `% of term`, used AS Used, billed AS Billed, forecast_end_pct AS `At term end`,
                   concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(end_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(end_date, '%b %Y')) AS `Term ends`, days_left AS `Days left`, measure AS Measure, drill
            FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1, 99, concat('   in the pool: ', l.channel), 'in pool', NULL, NULL, s.consumed, NULL, NULL,
                   concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(l.end_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(l.end_date, '%b %Y')), NULL, l.measure, concat('/d/n360-line?var-account=', l.account, '&var-line=', l.line_key)
            FROM n360.v_line_status AS s INNER JOIN n360.contract_line AS l ON l.line_key = s.line_key
            WHERE s.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND s.pool_id IS NOT NULL)
        ORDER BY o, r, Line

panels.title: % of billed over the term
panels.description:
Each line or pool's running total as % of its billed amount, from its start date (a pool as one line). The dashed line is 100% of billed. Days not read add nothing. Lines with no reading are left out.

**Source:** n360.line_day, n360.v_contract_status  
**Filter:** Customer; lines and pools with a billed amount  
**Window:** each term from its start date

targets.rawSql:
WITH ent AS (
            SELECT l.series_key AS sk, if(l.pool_id IS NULL, c1.line_label, c2.line_label) AS lab,
                   if(l.pool_id IS NULL, c1.billed, c2.billed) AS b, if(l.pool_id IS NULL, l.start_date, c2.start_date) AS st
            FROM n360.contract_line AS l
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT line_key, line_label, billed FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE entitlement = 'line') AS c1
                   ON c1.line_key = l.line_key
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT account, pool_id, line_label, billed, start_date FROM n360.v_contract_status
                       WHERE entitlement = 'pool') AS c2 ON c2.account = l.account AND c2.pool_id = l.pool_id
            WHERE l.account IN (${account:singlequote})),
             daily AS (SELECT d.day AS day, ent.lab AS lab, any(ent.b) AS b, sum(d.measured) AS m
                       FROM n360.line_day AS d INNER JOIN ent ON ent.sk = d.series_key
                       WHERE d.kind = 'line' AND d.day >= ent.st AND ent.b > 0 GROUP BY day, lab)
        SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, lab AS line,
               round(100 * sum(m) OVER (PARTITION BY lab ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) / b, 1) AS pct
        FROM daily ORDER BY time

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: no line with a billed amount

panels.title: Conversations, and containment
panels.description:
Conversations per day, week or month (Period picker) for the VAs chosen in the VA picker. The newest period is faded ("Still counting") while it is not over or holds days that may still settle. The line is containment (1 - handoffs / engaged, right axis), drawn only when the chosen VAs share one channel: containment is never added up across channels. Pick one VA to see its own.

**Source:** n360.va_day, n360.va  
**Filter:** Customer; VA  
**Window:** dashboard time range, by the Period picker

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') AS dt,
             (SELECT anomaly_provisional_days FROM n360.settings) AS settling
        SELECT toDateTime(b) AS time,
               if(partial, NULL, if(countIf(d.conversations IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sum(d.conversations))) AS Conversations,
               if(partial, if(countIf(d.conversations IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sum(d.conversations)), NULL) AS `Still counting`,
               -- containment only when the chosen VAs share one channel (never across channels)
               if(uniqExact(arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ',')) = 1 AND sum(d.engaged) > 0 AND countIf(d.handoffs IS NULL) = 0,
                  round(100 * (1 - sum(d.handoffs) / sum(d.engaged)), 1), NULL) AS `Containment %`
        FROM (SELECT *, multiIf(${period:singlequote} = 'day', day, ${period:singlequote} = 'month', toStartOfMonth(day), toMonday(day)) AS b,
                     multiIf(${period:singlequote} = 'day', day, ${period:singlequote} = 'month', toLastDayOfMonth(day), toMonday(day) + 6) AS b_end
              FROM n360.va_day) AS d
        INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = d.bot_id
        WHERE d.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND toString(d.bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(d.day)
        GROUP BY b, b_end > dt OR b_end > dt - settling AS partial ORDER BY time

panels.title: VAs
panels.description:
Every VA of this customer: engine and coverage (V8 playbooks against legacy intents, from the newest weekly configuration read), conversations and containment over the last 30 days against the 30 before. Containment is per VA, never across channels; "Not reported yet" where handoffs are not read. Flags: conversations down 10%+ or containment down 3+ points (proposed, n360.settings). Click a VA to open it.

**Source:** n360.v_va_change (n360.va_day), n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 60 days to the data-through day; the newest configuration read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.va AS VA, cfg.engine_version AS Engine, if(cfg.bot_id IS NULL, NULL, if(cfg.current_engine, 'V8 or later', 'Older'))
                   AS `Engine status`, cfg.v8_playbooks AS `V8 playbooks`, cfg.legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents`,
               c.convs_30 AS `Conversations, 30 days`, c.convs_change_pct AS `vs previous 30`,
               c.containment_30 AS Containment, c.containment_change_pts AS `Change (points)`,
               arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', [if(c.convs_down, 'Conversations down', ''),
                                                            if(c.containment_down, 'Containment down', '')]), ' · ') AS Flag,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', c.account, '&var-va=', toString(c.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.v_va_change AS c
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT toNullable(bot_id) AS bot_id, engine_version, current_engine, v8_playbooks, legacy_intents
                   FROM n360.v_va_config_latest) AS cfg ON cfg.bot_id = c.bot_id
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY `Conversations, 30 days` DESC

panels.title: Target features
panels.description:
Which target features this customer used in the last 30 days (proposed list). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_feature_use  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT feature AS Feature, if(used IS NULL, NULL, if(used, 'Used', 'Not used')) AS `Last 30 days`
        FROM n360.v_feature_use WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY feature

panels.title: Playbooks, last 31 days
panels.description:
Executions per playbook. "Built, not run" = authored and live but run 0 times (v1.1 "Authored, not live"). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.playbook_day  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pb.playbook AS Playbook, concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, sum(pb.executions) AS Executions,
               if(sum(pb.executions) = 0, 'Built, not run', 'Running') AS Status
        FROM n360.playbook_day AS pb INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = pb.bot_id
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND pb.day > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 31
        GROUP BY pb.playbook, v.va_name, v.channels ORDER BY Executions, Playbook

defaults.noValue: No playbook data for this customer

panels.title: Recent anomalies
panels.description:
Days a VA went silent, dropped (z of -4 or lower) or spiked (4 or higher) against the same weekday over the previous 8 weeks. Provisional days (the newest 3) may still change and never alert.

**Source:** n360.v_va_day_anomaly  
**Filter:** Customer; flagged days only  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(a.day)), ' ', formatDateTime(a.day, '%b %Y')) AS Day, concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, a.kind AS Kind, a.actual AS Actual, a.expected AS Expected,
               if(a.provisional, 'Provisional', 'Settled') AS State
        FROM n360.v_va_day_anomaly AS a INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = a.bot_id
        WHERE a.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND a.kind != 'normal' AND a.day > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 30
        ORDER BY a.day DESC

defaults.noValue: No flags in the last 30 days

panels.title: Requests
panels.description:
This customer's support tickets, open first; area and ask are tagged by hand ("Not tagged yet" until then). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(opened)), ' ', formatDateTime(opened, '%b %Y')) AS Opened, title AS Title, product_area AS Area, ask AS Ask, status AS Status
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY status = 'open' DESC, opened DESC
